title: German Creamy Garlic Soup
description: A hearty and comforting German-inspired soup made with creamy ingredients and a hint of garlic.
instructions: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Sprinkle flour over onion mixture and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Gradually add chicken broth, whisking continuously.
Bring mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add salmon pieces and cook until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
Heat soup to 165°F (74°C) to ensure food safety.
